svg.text: Student Records Web Application — Target Architecture
BMIT3273 Cloud Computing · AWS Academy Lab Project: Cloud Web Application Builder · updated with stages 19–21
(flow logs go to S3, not here — I-07)
HTTP:80 listener → target group App-TG · health check / · nodes in both Availability Zones · ALB-SG
route table asm-RT-App → 0.0.0.0/0 via asm-NAT (outbound only)
route table asm-RT-App → 0.0.0.0/0 via asm-NAT (outbound only)
Auto Scaling group App-ASG · min 2 / desired 2 / max 4
launch template App-LT-v1 · AMI App-Server-AMI-v1 · target tracking on average CPU 50% · warm-up 300s
Data-SG accepts App-SG only · LabInstanceProfile · Session Manager, no SSH
socat forwards TCP 3306 → asm-rds, run as systemd service db-forward.service
standalone instance, not in App-ASG — no automatic self-healing
both AZs' app instances reach it via Data-SG
route table asm-RT-DB — local route only, no path to the internet
route table asm-RT-DB — local route only, no path to the internet
db.t3.micro · 20 GiB gp3 · Single-AZ · Publicly accessible: No
database STUDENTS · automated backups, 7-day retention · DB-SG
DB-SG now accepts Data-SG only, not App-SG directly
db.t3.micro · Single-AZ · same region as asm-rds
read scaling — targets stage 16's DB-tier bottleneck finding
no RDS instance in this AZ
primary and replica both sit in asm-DB-A
subnet exists because RDS requires a DB subnet
DB subnet group asm-db-subnet-group (spans us-east-1a and us-east-1b)
GetSecretValue via LabRole — no credential stored on the instance or in the AMI
each tier accepts only the tier
in front of it; no stored password
in this Lab, first prod. upgrade)

Build-SG, the temporary group used to reach instances during construction, was deleted after the build and is not part of the delivered architecture. SNS scaling notifications (stage 18) omitted — lecturer ruled it too simple to count, kept as a bonus not shown here.
